title: Training Manager – Leadership Programmes (f/m/d)
description:
Lead the delivery of our leadership academy for 1,200 managers.

What you'll do
- Own the annual curriculum and budget of the academy
- Manage three trainers and a pool of external facilitators
- Evaluate programmes and present results to HR leadership

What you bring
- 7+ years in L&D, including leadership development
- Experience managing trainers or vendors
- Excellent English; German B2 is preferred because some cohorts are German-speaking
